html: † כְּנֵ֫מָא adv. accordingly, as follows (der. uncertain: NöGGA, 1884, 1021 Marti al. from כֵּן + indef. מָא, so somewhat, ungefähr so: v. older improb. view (as we should say, from כְּ and נֵימָא = נֵאמַר, cf. Talm. יֵימָא for יֵימַר) in Thes652): referring backwards, Ezr 6:13 כְּנֵמָא … עֲבַדוּ did accordingly; referring forwards, 4:8 כְנֵמָא כְּתַבוּ … wrote a letter … as follows, 5:4 (read c. 𝔊 אֲמַרוּ; אֲמַרְנָא from v 9, MeyEntst. J. 26), v 9, 11.
